environment: Local PGlite PostgreSQL, real SQL/RPCs, mocked Supabase Auth/Storage and PIN crypt
staff_creation: Covered separately by Edge Function mock tests; fixture authenticated staff used here

steps.name: Receive ingredients
steps.evidence: 20 eggs from supplier PO; duplicate receipt rejected; dated supplier lot retained

steps.name: Convert ingredient
steps.evidence: 6 eggs deducted once; 108 g yolk and 192 g white added with matching lot balances

steps.name: Create recipe
steps.evidence: 4-unit recipe uses 50 g yolk and 80 g white, plus labor/overhead/packaging costs

steps.name: Produce goods
steps.evidence: 4 finished units; production cannot complete twice; expiry and cost snapshots retained

steps.name: Review variance
steps.evidence: Extra 1 g yolk consumed once; duplicate variance rejected

steps.name: Record waste
steps.evidence: Damaged finished unit removed through audited stock/lot workflow

steps.name: Publish catalogue and promotion
steps.evidence: Customer payload exposes description/allergens/notes and variant price $9, without costs/supplier/recipe fields

steps.name: Kitchen and ready display
steps.evidence: Friendly order number moves Preparing → Ready with public order-number-only status

steps.name: POS, receipt, inventory and cash
steps.evidence: One $9 variant sale, $10 tender/$1 change; stock 3→2 and daily cash $50→$59

steps.name: Reports and profitability
steps.evidence: Saved sale and cost snapshot appear in management/profitability reporting

steps.name: Refund
steps.evidence: Full return restores one traced unit and reverses $9 cash once (PIN crypt mocked in local engine)

steps.name: Pre-orders and custom cakes
steps.evidence: Pickup order applies $2 deposit/$7 balance and deducts one unit; special cake retains size/flavor/filling/frosting/theme/message and $5 deposit on a $25 quote

steps.name: Backup/export
steps.evidence: Variant, conversion, pre-order, catalogue and checkout history are included in the protected RC1 extension; passwords/PIN hashes excluded

steps.name: Audit and close day
steps.evidence: Audit records exist; counted $50 closes the day with immutable closure and cannot reopen

remaining: Hosted concurrent connections and lock-contention testing
